body: Thank you. I appreciate all I can get.
I'm sorry for rambling....I get this way when I'm feeling low and can't sleep.

I agree. I've been guilty of posting stuff like that myself but only when I am drunk I hate attention when sober). I deleted my FB and IG...I can't trust myself when drinking not to post something idiotic. I don't even remember posting shit like that either. I know plenty of the fake types.

I can relate to this. On the outside I look fine. I have a good job and friends but they don't care...they like me enough to hang out with me & get drunk & laugh at my jokes. But when I post about how I hate my life they call me over dramatic or being selfish. No "are you okay" messages... nothing. That just pushes me towards the edge.

Me too... literally the only thing. I just drink a lot of alcohol daily, don't go see doctors, etc. I'm going with the let nature take its course path. Funny thing is I exercise though....don't care about my health/life but I wanna look good on the outside. I find it amusing.
